help: Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to every ship in the player's fleet. Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to one ship in the player's fleet, found by its name (or part of it). Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Adds copies of every hull item type to the player's cargo, each with a random roll. Defaults to 5 copies of each if no number is given, and at most 200 can be granted at once.
Adds one copy of every unique hull item to the player's cargo, each with a random roll.
Adds Hull Upgrades for every hull size to the player's cargo. Defaults to 3 of each size if no number is given, and at most 50 of each can be granted at once.

Opens a Star Chart wormhole beside the player fleet, in hyperspace or a star system, leading to a generated star system with fleets, points of interest and an objective. The optional seed (a whole number), system type (SINGLE, BINARY_CLOSE, BINARY_FAR, TRINARY_2CLOSE, TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR or TRINARY_2FAR) and tier (1 to 15, default 1, written as a number or tier=N) can come in any order and reproduce a system; seed and type are random when left out. Prints the seed, type, tier and objective used. Only one run can be open at a time. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.

Shows the open Star Chart run, if any: its layout seed and type, tier, objective and objective progress, its fleet and point-of-interest counts and what its system still contains, plus counts of chart systems, chart-tagged entities, hyperspace entities, fleets, scripts, listeners, used procgen names, Economy markets and intel, to check that closed runs leave nothing behind.

Generates, opens and closes the given number of full Star Chart systems (layout, fleets and points of interest) back to back without moving the player, cycling seeds, system types and tiers 1 to 15, then reports whether the used procgen names, Hyperspace Topography scans, star systems, hyperspace entities, chart-tagged entities, fleets, scripts, listeners, Economy markets and intel are unchanged. Defaults to 10, at most 500. Runs over several frames after the console closes.

Adds random Star Charts to the player's cargo, each rolled at the given tier with its implicit and random prefixes and suffixes. Count defaults to 5 (at most 50) and tier to 1 (1 to 15). Open the Star Charts tab in the Items panel (or use ExiledSectorChartList) to move them into Star Chart storage. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.
Moves any Star Charts in the player's cargo into Star Chart storage, then lists every stored chart with its index, name, rarity, tier, system type, implicit and modifiers.

Opens a Star Chart wormhole beside the player fleet from the stored chart with the given index (see ExiledSectorChartList). The chart is used up, and its tier, system type, seed and modifiers shape the system. Only one run can be open at a time; a failed opening keeps the chart. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.
